summary.overview: Session-limited evidence: one read-only inspection episode with no changes, checks, or friction. The project has a custom static quality gate (check-plugin.mjs), a tag-triggered CI release workflow, an audit trail, and transaction-protected checkpoint finalization, but zero behavioral tests and no local WordPress runtime. All specialist candidates were deferred under evidence-eligibility gates — the scan-transaction inconsistency, zero-test coverage, and string-matching gate brittleness are future-only risks or absence claims, not observed consequences. Learning Capture is not applicable (requires two comparable windows).

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: AGENTS.md routes UI design context via the premium skill, but no task episode with changes was observed to confirm goal understanding, relevant-context application, or scope-boundary enforcement.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Build and check scripts are documented and runnable (npm run check, npm run build), but no local WordPress environment exists and no task episode exercised the permission boundary.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: A static quality gate (check-plugin.mjs) enforces 50+ architectural invariants, but zero behavioral tests exist and no change was observed to validate. The gate uses string-matching, not behavioral verification.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: A tag-triggered CI release workflow and event-level recovery (reset_event_data, uninstall, audit trail, close_checkpoint transaction) exist, but no delivery was observed and the CI pipeline has no pre-release test gate.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: Bounded review completed but not applicable: only one read-only episode is available, which is insufficient to detect repeated workflows, route demand into durable owners, or compare later outcomes.
